title: Squared stable influence estimate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function. The square of the total stable influence of its real-valued sign representation at parameter $1/3$ is at most the maximum coordinate influence of $f$ times the square of the total influence of that sign representation.
